pages.title: Choose an Offering
pages.text: Choose a pump by its offering: furnace fuel, nearby light, falls, struck projectiles, or powered redstone wire. Alternating forms vary the transfer rate over time. See $(l:aura:first_aura_circuit)the first circuit$(/l) for a working route.

pages.title: Burning
pages.text: Dropped furnace fuel supplies stored run time; containers are consumed too. The pump draws colored Aura from its level and moves it to the first reachable network block above.

pages.title: Illumination
pages.text: Glowstone and torches beside the pump are consumed to fuel an upward transfer.

pages.title: Momentum
pages.text: A nearby entity's fall feeds the pump; longer falls grant a longer run at the same nominal speed.

pages.title: Projectiles
pages.text: Arrows, eggs, and snowballs that strike the pump each provide a different amount of fuel and speed.

pages.title: Redstone
pages.text: The pump consumes powered redstone wire it can follow; a gap ends each wire path.

pages.title: Light and Fall Offers
pages.text: At one-block rise, Glowstone gives 180 eligible seconds at 750 Aura per second; Torch, 30 at 750. Falls add 2 seconds per block at 500. Furnace fuel grants its burn time divided by five at 300.

pages.title: Projectile and Wire
pages.text: An Arrow gives 20 seconds at 1,000 Aura per second; an Egg, 90 at 500; a Snowball, 10 at 500. Powered wire starts at 10 seconds and 1,500; each following wire adds 40% duration, up to 15.

pages.title: Alternating Rhythm
pages.text: Alternating offers triple accepted nominal speed, then a sine-like wave varies transfer from none to full. One rise-and-fall cycle lasts 20,000 world ticks: 16 minutes 40 seconds at 20 ticks per second.
